name: user agent features of static credentials

files.home/.aws/config:
[default]
region = us-east-1
aws_access_key_id = AKID
aws_secret_access_key = SECRET
s3 =
  addressing_style = path
  preferred_transfer_client = classic

[profile acct]
region = us-east-1
aws_access_key_id = AKID
aws_secret_access_key = SECRET
aws_account_id = 123456789012

[profile gz]

aws_access_key_id = AKID
aws_secret_access_key = SECRET
request_min_compression_size_bytes = 1

[profile src]
aws_access_key_id = AKIDSRC
aws_secret_access_key = SECRETSRC

[profile role]

role_session_name = sess
source_profile = src
region = us-east-1
endpoint_url = {endpoint}

  addressing_style = path
  preferred_transfer_client = classic
